name: contrail
description: Air traffic control for coding agents — the next GitHub, built on Cloudflare Workers + Artifacts

paragraphs: Air traffic control for coding agents. Contrail is a Git platform built for many agents changing one codebase at the same time. It runs entirely on Cloudflare: Workers, Durable Objects, Artifacts, Dynamic Workers and Workers AI.

Live: · Demo video (7 min): · Replays: Ramda, Bookshop, incident, 100 scripted agents · Scale: 1,000 scripted agents in one monorepo of 10 sectors · Crossings: one change landed in three sectors at once
GitHub assumes a few people taking turns: a branch per person, a pull request per change, and a human review in between. With a hundred agents working at once, that model fails in predictable ways:
features: Agents collide late. Two agents edit the same function in separate branches. Nobody finds out
Agents are blind to each other. No agent knows what the others are about to change.
Review doesn't scale. A human can't read 300 pull requests a day.
The why is lost. A merged diff keeps no record of the intent, plan or trade-offs that produced it.
